accepted_design: Mapping and independent revision approval hashes bind the actual source and counterpart; source spans are independently range checked and hashed.
Runner retains review identity; matrix replays authority and current fixture integrity, preserving separate supplemental_native_equivalents instead of labelling inactive originals unchanged.
Synthetic tests mutate inner source spans and approval decisions with outer hashes updated, exercising substantive checks.

findings.requested_change: Require nonempty author and reject empty-author synthetic case.
findings.problem: Both mapping.author and review.author can be empty while reviewer is nonempty; current equality tests accept missing authorship.

findings.requested_change: Require exact declared marker set or verify each declared marker uniquely in captured stdout; reject a nonempty marker absent from execution.
findings.problem: required_marker is only nonempty-checked; execution validates fixed markers rather than the mapping-declared required marker. Current mapping agrees, but future approved witness drift would not be enforced.

resolved_findings.resolution: Nonempty mapping author now mandatory; review author must equal it and differ from reviewer. Empty-author rejection regression added.

Shared Assert-NativeBranchWitnesses uses escaped exact-line matching and requires each approved marker exactly once. Runner and matrix call it against actual captured output. Missing declared marker and duplicate witness regressions added.
